Hairdressing and barbers' services for men and boys
Hairdressing and barbers' services for men and boys
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.7: activities a hairdresser usually performs on human hair (cutting, washing, blow drying, dyeing, shaving etc). Products that hairdressers use when treating hair ( shampoo, hair dye, etc.) and inexpensive hair ornaments incorporated into a hairstyle that are not separately charged and application of hair extensions and measurement and overhaul of wigs and toupees are also included. The material used for those services (hair extension, wig or toupee) is excluded.
